data.research_question: Does the July 2026 I-75 road-rage incident and public criminal-history context support inclusion in the violent-offenders dataset?
data.method: Normalize current incident, visual evidence, charges, limited historical public-record context, and incident geography into StarIntel Document v0.9.0 while omitting all victim identifiers.
classification_rules: Include named alleged offender/defendant when a violent or threatened-violence incident is supported by direct visual evidence and law-enforcement-based reporting.
Keep pending criminal allegations explicitly marked pending adjudication.
Do not create victim person records or include victim identifiers.
Represent incident geography with location/geo documents and common geospatial metadata.

findings.finding: Video-based reporting shows a handgun being pointed toward another vehicle during the road-rage encounter.
Patascher was arrested and faces three listed charges, including aggravated assault with a deadly weapon and felon in possession of a firearm.
Public reporting places the incident on southbound I-75 near U.S. 301 / Exit 254 in Hillsborough County.
The packet intentionally omits all victim identities and does not create victim entity records.
